newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Treasurer names muni information depository.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Treasurer names muni information depository.

text.p: State Treasurer J. Kenneth Blackwell said Thursday he would name the Ohio Municipal Advisory Council as the state's official information depository for continuing municipal bond disclosure.
The depository would assist bond underwriters to comply with Securities and Exchange Commission rules regarding disclosure on municipal bond deals.

SEC regulations permit states to name private or public depositories to meet the disclosure requirement. The Ohio council was the only organization to respond to the state's request for qualifications, Blackwell said in a statement.
